name: Can I replace my bathtub with a shower unit instead?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my bathtub with a shower unit instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can absolutely replace your bathtub with a shower unit, a process often referred to as a tub-to-shower conversion. This is a common renovation, especially for homeowners looking to create a more accessible bathroom or optimize space. The project involves removing the bathtub and installing a new shower base, walls, and fixtures. While it frees up space and can improve accessibility, it also means losing the option for a bath, which is a practical tradeoff to consider if you enjoy soaking or have young children.
